beats.say: The ocean is not one place but three, stacked on top of each other like the floors of a building.
In the sunlit zone there is enough light for plants to grow, so this is where most sea life lives.
Below that, in the twilight zone, the light fades fast and the water gets cold, down to about a thousand meters.
And in the midnight zone it is pitch black, so animals make their own light to find food and each other.
